member.name: ChangeMarkerMargin.Class
member.summary: Displays a marker beside every visible marked line reported by an .

remarks.para: The marker and the reserved width scale with the margin's font size.

The bar drawing is this margin's non-normative sample: a 4-DIP bar, sized to the familiar diff-view look instead of the 16-DIP reserved width the base class uses for icon margins. A host that wants its own identity assigns and ; a derived margin can override for a different marker shape, or derive from directly for a different marker model.

member.name: SampleMarkerBrush
member.summary: Gets the sample marker brush the margin installs as its non-normative default: a blue brush suitable for a change bar.
member.remarks: The default exists so a change-marker margin is visible without configuration. A host that wants its own identity assigns (or overrides the property's default value in a derived margin).

member.name: MarkerBrush
member.summary: Gets or sets the brush used to draw change markers.
member.remarks: The default is a sample value chosen to be visible in common themes; hosts should set it to match their own theme.

member.name: ChangeMarkerMargin
member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
member.param: The source whose marked lines are rendered.
